summary: Macro Bank Inc. (Banco Macro S.A.) filed a Form 6-K containing its 2Q26 earnings release. The report details quarterly results: net income of Ps.206.8 billion, operating income, deposits, loans, capital ratios, and asset quality metrics. It is a routine earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews. The filing includes regulatory updates but no transactional components. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation.
